## Agent

New agent name or existing agent to change.

## User need

Who would dispatch this agent, and what job would it do?

## Scope

What this agent owns, and what it explicitly defers to another lens or operator.

## Public-safety check

Confirm that the proposal contains no private paths, private workspace names,
credentials, personal data, or unpublished agent/plugin references.

## Acceptance criteria

How should maintainers know the agent is useful and bounded?
